trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitudes along the dorsal trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature trajectory extending from the water line to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, high-contrast clusters of white and reddish-brown pixel intensities at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant textured bio-fouling clusters present at the lateral extremities of the fluke lobes.
